prompt:
You will read a short workplace conversation, then a final instruction given only as a minimal reference object (no act, no verb) instead of a plain sentence or a full structured message.

Turn 1 — Colleague: "Can you get invoice-march.pdf ready to send to Priya?"
Turn 2 — You: "Sure."
Turn 3 — Colleague: "Also, take a look at invoice-march-revised.pdf."
Turn 4 — You: "OK."
Turn 5 — Colleague: "And invoice-march-final.pdf needs attention too."
Turn 6 — You: "Noted."
Turn 7 — Colleague sends only:
{ "patient": "invoice-march.pdf", "recipient": "priya" }

(There is no verb and no explicit act in Turn 7 — treat it as pointing at the file and person the earlier conversation's pending action concerns.)

Question: which file (by exact filename) is Turn 7 about, and who is the recipient?

End your answer with a single JSON object on its own line: {"entity": "<filename or 'cannot_determine'>", "recipient": "<name or 'cannot_determine'>", "confidence": "<low|medium|high>"}

metadata.description: Structural replica of entity-case1-minimal_structured (invoice domain). Uses the entity-only structured-object MAMP shape, not the sentence+bracket-annotation shape.
metadata.known_limitation: Same as entity-case1-minimal_structured: cannot test act-conveyance, only referent resolution.
